geometry: Three white sections of a right-aligned triangular wedge, with a shared straight diagonal edge and two horizontal transparent gaps. The 20 by 20 source has ink spanning approximately x=5 to 15 and y=1 to 19, with one-pixel gaps at y=4 and y=8.
limitations: The antialiased diagonal is reconstructed as a single ideal straight edge; native pixel coverage may differ slightly from the source. Native and 8x SVG renders were visually inspected.
